review_notes: I read the whole file. It builds an AddCommMonoid structure on hom-sets from binary biproducts, using the Eckmann-Hilton argument. It also proves add_comp and comp_add. I searched Mathlib for competing constructions: leftAdd, rightAdd, semiadditive, Presemiadditive, AddCommMonoid (X ⟶ Y), and the biprod.lift/biprod.desc addition pattern. The only related match was Preadditive/Biproducts.lean:631. That is a lemma about an existing preadditive addition, not an independent structure, so it is outside this rubric. The Presemiadditive instance for SemimoduleCat is a different concept. leftAdd and rightAdd are used only to prove the Eckmann-Hilton hypotheses and are not a competing API. I found no duplicate concept to consolidate.
